findings.message: The fast toss (10 m/s) apex is at y=60, and the callout boxes sit at y=40 to 96. The apex is 170 px above the launch mark, which is 34 px per metre. The scene scale is fixed, so this is consistent. The top of the lane is y=34, so the ball (radius 18) at y=60 is only just inside it. This is fine and I can't judge clipping without pixels.

At the endpoint, the Motion arrow points down and has length 60. Its tip at y=290 is below the lane box, which ends at y=266. The arrow may extend outside the lane. This can't be judged without pixels.
